references.summary: Cool-season annual harvested for dry seed. Frost sensitivity changes by cultivar and reproductive stage. Heat and drought during flowering and seed filling can reduce pod set and seed weight. Alternate with non-host crops according to the disease; avoid treating all legume-to-legume sequences as breaks. Harvest maturity and shattering risk differ from an early green harvest; no Moroccan cycle length is supplied by these notes.
